name: owl-diff-search
description: Search Git diffs by intent and open matching changes in VS Code's native diff editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: OwlDiffSearch executes Git and a local Python model server in the open workspace.

owlDiffSearch.modelName.description: Hugging Face model used for semantic diff search.

owlDiffSearch.batchSize.description: Embedding batch size. Lower this if indexing uses too much memory.

autoClearCache.description: Clear the local semantic index when the server starts.

autoRemoveVenv.description: Recreate the bundled virtual environment during setup.

pythonVersion.description: Python version or interpreter path passed to uv.

owlDiffSearch.enableJapaneseTranslation.description: Translate Japanese queries to English with Gemini before Semantic, Hybrid or BM25 search. Query expansion includes translation when enabled.

owlDiffSearch.enableQueryExpansion.description: Use Gemini to rewrite queries into English search descriptions suited to the search mode and embedding model. Includes translation; disabled for Keyword search.

owlDiffSearch.geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key used for query translation, expansion and agentic search.

owlDiffSearch.enableAgenticSearch.description: Let Gemini review retrieved diff excerpts and iteratively refine queries and search modes. Sends search queries, result titles, paths and diff excerpts to Gemini. Overrides translation and expansion while enabled.

owlDiffSearch.agenticMaxSearches.description: Maximum local searches per agentic run. Gemini is called at most this many times plus one final review and up to two recovery attempts for transient errors or malformed tool responses.

owlDiffSearch.geminiModel.description: Gemini model used for query translation and expansion. Defaults to Gemini 3.8 Flash (latest stable Flash verified September 10, 2026).

owlDiffSearch.serverHost.description: Address used by the local diff-search server. Restart after changing it.

owlDiffSearch.serverPort.description: Preferred local server port. Nearby ports are tried automatically if it is busy.

owlDiffSearch.autoStartServer.description: Start the local search server when the extension activates.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
